item.title: Multiple Language Support for ebitenengine in Go.
item.description: Intro This tutorial will show you how to make a text abstraction that you can easily plug in buttons, menus etc and easily change your entire game language.No time to waste lets go ! Requirements You will need Go installed and some pre-requisites for ebitenengine. You can find the full instructions here I suggest you make sure you have the example shown there running first. This will be the base for our tutorial.
